subject: OpenRGD SO-101 Embodiment Lab
scope: LeRobot SO-101 leader/follower laboratory; not a normative OpenRGD conformance or physical-safety certification.
interpretation: Operator-confirmed observations from prior work sessions are reported as such, not independently audited measurements. No public raw dataset, checksum, calibration bundle or execution trace has been attached.

platform.platform: SO-101 follower arm + SO-101 leader arm

observations.conclusion: The SO-101 leader and follower were configured/calibrated; operator reported that the black leader moved the white follower.
observations.caveat: Calibration file contents and motor bus state were not re-audited in this publication.

observations.conclusion: A local non-video smoke recording was reported as episode 0, 448 samples, followed by a clean stop.
observations.caveat: The dataset is not linked as a public Hub repository. A small recording is not a training set or a task-success benchmark; effective sample timing has not been independently recomputed.

observations.conclusion: A replay of the local smoke episode was reported to have executed correctly.
observations.caveat: No replay timestamps, encoder trace or quantitative trajectory error are publicly archived.

observations.conclusion: Leader/follower teleoperation was again confirmed working after troubleshooting.
observations.caveat: This is an operator assessment of teleoperation, not a measured tracking or latency result.
